ns2:course.label: Advanced Readings in Spanish
ns2:course.description: Directed reading course intended to develop an advanced student's interest in a special area of Hispanic linguistics or literature (author, genre, period, group of works, etc. ). Topics to be chosen in consultation with an advisor. Only topics not covered in regular offerings will be considered. May be repeated if topics vary. 1 to 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: SPAN 302 for linguistics topics; and any two of SPAN 450, SPAN 452, SPAN 454, or SPAN 456 for literature topics.
